Redmi Note 12 Series

Designing a Scalable Launch System Across Product, Platform, and Physical Worlds

ROLE

Visual Direction,
Campaign Design

SCOPE

Key Visual, Product Exp,
OOH, Launch Event

YEAR

2023

1. THE PRODUCT

About the Series

The Redmi Note 12 Series was positioned as a performance-first smartphone lineup, combining a 200MP camera, 5G capability, and a refined design language.

The goal was to create a visual system that elevates the product beyond its segment.

Colours & Variants

A range of finishes designed to feel bold, modern, and premium. Showcasing material feel, light interaction, and distraction-free presentation.

Arctic White

Frosted Green

Glacier Blue

Iceberg Blue

Matte Black

Mystique Blue

Onyx Black

Stardust Purple

THE BRIEF

Design a launch system that:
1

Works across digital, web, and physical environments.

2

Highlights key features like camera and performance.

3

Maintains consistency from mobile screens to large-scale formats.

One system.
Multiple touchpoints.

2. THE KEY VISUAL

The Idea

The product was positioned as “SuperNote” — powerful, precise, and larger than life. The approach moved away from conventional product advertising to:

Cinematic storytelling
Strong environmental scale
Product-first compositions

Master Key Visual

The foundation of the entire campaign.

Exploration

Initial explorations focused on defining a visual language that balances innovation with clarity. This included lighting studies, camera-led compositions, and environmental storytelling.

Designed as a cinematic reveal
Focused on depth, contrast, and dominance
Built to adapt across formats
Exploration 1
Exploration 2
Exploration 3
Exploration 4
Exploration 5
Exploration 6
Exploration 7
On Stage

The same visual system extended into launch presentations and large-format displays. Designed for high-impact screens, structured for clarity at scale, maintaining consistency everywhere.

3. PRODUCT EXPERIENCE

Product Page

The visual system was translated into a live product experience, ensuring consistency between campaign and conversion.

1
Integrated storytelling with product highlights
2
Maintained visual hierarchy across sections
3
Optimized for clarity, flow, and engagement

👉
From campaign to conversion — one continuous experience.

mi.com/in/product/redmi-note-12

4. THE ROLLOUT

In the Wild

The campaign was executed across multiple cities in India, spanning Billboards, Metro panels, and Retail displays. Design focused on instant readability, strong visual recall, and clear feature communication.

Launch Experience

The on-ground launch brought the system to life with large-scale presentation design and screen-first storytelling. Cohesive visual language across stage and media.

Impact
Built a unified visual system across all touchpoints.
Successfully scaled from digital to physical environments.
Elevated perception of the product as premium and performance-driven.
Let's build design that doesn't just look good —
but works everywhere.

DriveX Diwali Campaign

Ride Back Home

ROLE

Design Lead

SCOPE

Key Visual, Storyboard,
Print Medium

YEAR

2025

THE CHALLENGE

Design a campaign that:
1

Speaks to people who couldn’t go home for Diwali

2

Feels festive without falling into clichés

3

Balances emotion with a subtle, relatable tone

4

Scales seamlessly across video, KV, and print

One idea.
Multiple emotions.

THE IDEA

Ride Back Home
“Ride Back Home” reimagined through last-minute urgency
For those who decide late—but still make it home
Focused on emotional connection over location
Rooted in real, everyday moments
Loading Film...
On Screen
Film built on a simple human insight
Captures absence, resolves with connection
Avoided over-dramatic storytelling
Designed for digital-first consumption
Key Visual
Alt KVs
Impact
Strong emotional resonance
High recall across formats
Cohesive storytelling across touchpoints
Elevated festive communication for DriveX
We didn’t just celebrate Diwali.
We made it feel closer.

Marketplace Listing Creative

Designing high-conversion marketplace assets across Amazon and Flipkart for multiple brands.

ROLE

Design Lead

SCOPE

Catalogue Design, A+ Content,
Amazon & Flipkart Assets,
Visual Refresh, Conversion-Focused Design

YEAR

2025

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Balancing brand story with performance.

“I worked on marketplace creatives for Lumio, Amazfit, and Mivi, focusing on building visually consistent and high-performing listing assets. The goal was to balance brand storytelling with clear product communication, optimized for conversion across e-commerce platforms.”

PROJECT

CONTENT
Designed a 5-day preheat campaign using marketplace banners
Each banner revealed a key product feature
Strong visual identity built around Lumio’s neon green brand language
Focused on building anticipation and visual recall
VISUAL DIRECTION
High contrast
Neon green dominant palette
Futuristic, energetic look

PROJECT

CONTENT
Refreshed product listing assets
Followed existing brand guidelines closely
Improved visual clarity and hierarchy
Ensured consistency across catalogue and A+ content
VISUAL DIRECTION
Clean, minimal
Premium fitness-tech aesthetic
Structured layouts

PROJECT

CONTENT
Refreshed catalogue assets for Amazon and Flipkart
Applied a copy-first design approach
Focused on clear messaging and feature communication
Designed for quick scanning and high engagement
VISUAL DIRECTION
Bold typography
Clean layout system
Communication-first visuals
Designing for marketplaces isn’t just about visuals—

it’s about clarity, speed, and conversion.

Banner Refresh

Rebuilding banner visuals using AI-assisted, node-based workflows for better control and output.

ROLE

Design Lead

SCOPE

Banner Design, Image Gen,
AI Workflow, Visual Enhancement

YEAR

2026

PROJECT OVERVIEW

From stock-heavy to premium logic.
Refreshed existing banners with a focus on stronger visuals
Moved away from stock-heavy imagery
Built a node-based workflow using Nano Banana in Freepik Spaces
Focused on control, consistency, and premium output
ACTIVE
MODULE 01: PROFESSIONAL PHOTOGRAPHY
INPUT
Raw Image
PROMPT
AI Prompt

Use a shallow depth-of-field shot at 85mm f/1.8, featuring a portrait of two people shaking hands. Do not alter the posture of the individuals, and keep their faces and expressions unchanged.

OUTPUT
Final Image

MODULE 01

Professional Portraiture
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Capture a professional shot using the available camera and lens setup
STEP 02
Provide a prompt to enhance the image, making it look more premium and studio-shot
STEP 03
Iterate on the output to achieve the desired final quality

MODULE 02

Scene Change
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Input the model shot with the existing setting and pointer
STEP 02
Select a location that matches the perspective
STEP 03
Provide prompts to seamlessly integrate the scene
STEP 04
Iterate until the desired final result is achieved
ACTIVE
MODULE 02: SCENE CHANGE
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
PROMPT
Text Prompt

shot of people at location, captured as a realistic portrait using an 85mm lens at f/1.8. Maintain natural lighting, authentic skin tones, and realistic depth of field.

OUTPUT
Final Image
ACTIVE
MODULE 03: ENVIRONMENT REBUILD
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
PROMPT
Text Prompt

@shot of people and a scooter from this image, placed at @location. Ensure the integration looks seamless and natural, as if captured in a single frame. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/1.8 with realistic lighting, depth of field, and perspective.

OUTPUT
Final Image

MODULE 03

Environment Rebuild
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Start with the subject image, preserving the original pose and framing
STEP 02
Break down the perspective, lighting direction, and depth cues of the shot
STEP 03
Introduce a new environment that aligns with these visual parameters
STEP 04
Guide the transformation using precise prompts for seamless blending
STEP 05
Continuously refine details until the final output looks naturally captured in the new setting

MODULE 04

Styling & Localization
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Use the base model shot while keeping the original pose and composition intact
STEP 02
Modify the attire to suit the target audience and context
STEP 03
Place the subjects in a localized environment that reflects regional relevance
STEP 04
Ensure the styling and location feel naturally connected
STEP 05
Iterate until the final output looks authentic and culturally aligned
ACTIVE
MODULE 04: STYLING & LOCALIZATION
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
INPUT
Attire
PROMPT
Text Prompt

Place the @shot subjects on the porch of a house at @location, ensuring a realistic and seamless integration. Shot on a Canon 1DX with an 85mm f/1.8 lens. Adjust the house perspective if needed, keep the scooter present, maintain original posture, and ensure correct proportions. The seller model is wearing @attire.

OUTPUT
Final Image
Designing banners is no longer just about placement—

it’s about building the image itself.

Rebuilding banner visuals using AI-assisted, node-based workflows for better control and output.

ROLE

Design Lead

SCOPE

Banner Design, Image Gen,
AI Workflow, Visual Enhancement

YEAR

2026

PROJECT OVERVIEW

From stock-heavy to premium logic.
Refreshed existing banners with a focus on stronger visuals
Moved away from stock-heavy imagery
Built a node-based workflow using Nano Banana in Freepik Spaces
Focused on control, consistency, and premium output
ACTIVE
MODULE 01: PROFESSIONAL PHOTOGRAPHY
INPUT
Raw Image
PROMPT
AI Prompt

Use a shallow depth-of-field shot at 85mm f/1.8, featuring a portrait of two people shaking hands. Do not alter the posture of the individuals, and keep their faces and expressions unchanged.

OUTPUT
Final Image

MODULE 01

Professional Portraiture
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Capture a professional shot using the available camera and lens setup
STEP 02
Provide a prompt to enhance the image, making it look more premium and studio-shot
STEP 03
Iterate on the output to achieve the desired final quality

MODULE 02

Scene Change
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Input the model shot with the existing setting and pointer
STEP 02
Select a location that matches the perspective
STEP 03
Provide prompts to seamlessly integrate the scene
STEP 04
Iterate until the desired final result is achieved
ACTIVE
MODULE 02: SCENE CHANGE
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
PROMPT
Text Prompt

shot of people at location, captured as a realistic portrait using an 85mm lens at f/1.8. Maintain natural lighting, authentic skin tones, and realistic depth of field.

OUTPUT
Final Image
ACTIVE
MODULE 03: ENVIRONMENT REBUILD
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
PROMPT
Text Prompt

@shot of people and a scooter from this image, placed at @location. Ensure the integration looks seamless and natural, as if captured in a single frame. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/1.8 with realistic lighting, depth of field, and perspective.

OUTPUT
Final Image

MODULE 03

Environment Rebuild
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Start with the subject image, preserving the original pose and framing
STEP 02
Break down the perspective, lighting direction, and depth cues of the shot
STEP 03
Introduce a new environment that aligns with these visual parameters
STEP 04
Guide the transformation using precise prompts for seamless blending
STEP 05
Continuously refine details until the final output looks naturally captured in the new setting

MODULE 04

Styling & Localization
BREAKDOWN
STEP 01
Use the base model shot while keeping the original pose and composition intact
STEP 02
Modify the attire to suit the target audience and context
STEP 03
Place the subjects in a localized environment that reflects regional relevance
STEP 04
Ensure the styling and location feel naturally connected
STEP 05
Iterate until the final output looks authentic and culturally aligned
ACTIVE
MODULE 04: STYLING & LOCALIZATION
INPUT
Shot
INPUT
Location
INPUT
Attire
PROMPT
Text Prompt

Place the @shot subjects on the porch of a house at @location, ensuring a realistic and seamless integration. Shot on a Canon 1DX with an 85mm f/1.8 lens. Adjust the house perspective if needed, keep the scooter present, maintain original posture, and ensure correct proportions. The seller model is wearing @attire.

OUTPUT
Final Image

it’s about building the image itself.
